§aThe top of the food chain.§f

§6Schrabidium Armor§f: 10 defense, 3.0 RR, hard cap 4, damage mod 0.1. Haste III, Strength III, Jump Boost II, Speed III. Fireproof. Needs Starmetal base plus Ionized Particles.

§6CMB Steel Armor§f: 10 defense, 1.3 RR, hard cap 2, damage mod 0.05. Speed III, Haste III, Strength. Fireproof. More accessible than Schrabidium and arguably the better all-rounder.

§6Dineutronium Armor§f: 2 defense, 5.0 damage mod. That damage modifier means you take MORE damage. Pure meme armor. Wear it for the flex.

§ePS:§f Schrabidium and CMB are the two practical endgame sets. CMB is easier to craft, Schrabidium has the RR edge.
